newsitem.title: USA: NIMO seeks up to 350,000 bbls of fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NIMO seeks up to 350,000 bbls of fuel oil.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp (NIMO) issued a tender Thursday seeking up to 350,000 barrels of fuel oil for two generation stations in upstate New York, a company official said Thursday.
The Syracuse, N.Y., utility requested bids for 100,000 to 150,000 barrels of 0.7 percent sulphur, and 100,000 to 200,000 barrels of 1.5 percent sulphur fuel oil, he said.

The company specified that the 0.7 percent barrels be delivered to its Oswego facility between end-October and early November, and the 1.5 percent grade to its Albany plant between November 1 and the end of the year, he said.
Both grades must meet pour point specification of 60 degrees Fahrenheit; flash point 150 degrees; and gravity between 10 and 24 degrees on the API scale, he said.
Parties must send letters expressing interest to bid by Friday, and formal requests must be submitted by late Tuesday, Oct 8, the NIMO official said.
The utility would evaluate fix-priced bids or those based on market reference postings, he said.
In the New York harbor, 0.7 percent fuel oil was last quoted at $19.25-$19.50 a barrel, and 1.5 percent at $18.25-$18.50.
